column3: With respect to the Market Place Center Mortgage Loan (8.7%), the loan documents provide that, following the lockout period, the borrower may obtain the release of not more than two adjacent buildings in connection with a sale on an arms-length basis (includes affiliates), subject to certain conditions, including: (i) no event of default shall have occurred or be continuing, (ii) partial defeasance of the loan in an amount equal to greater of (A) 110% of the allocated amount for the release property, (B) the post-release DSCR (interest-only) of the remaining properties’ being no less than the greater of the pre-release DSCR (interest-only) for the entire property and 2.42x, and (C) the post-release LTV of the remaining properties’ being no less than the greater of the pre-release LTV for the entire property and 50.9%; and (D) an amount sufficient to comply with related REMIC requirements; (iii) a rating agency confirmation; and (iv) an opinion of counsel that the partial release complies with REMIC requirements.
